costs: Each leg pays max(1 USD,0.005 USD/share) commission and 1bp adverse allowance; sell leg additionally pays 0.00003*notional +0.000166 USD/share. Frozen conservative assumptions, not asserted historical or competition fees. Observed spread is in entry/exit prices.
bad_data: Any BAD_TS_RECV record makes that symbol-session's screen unassessable; do not silently delete it and resurrect a prior quote. Invalid completed books remain in the path. Matching timestamps may differ across anonymized component venues, so do not invent a global matching sequence or venue mapping. Clock consistency permits at most 1ms event-ahead-of-capture and at most 1s capture delay per input; endpoints have the stricter 250ms ages. Unassessable sessions and unknown reference windows are never zero P&L.
feed_limits: EQUS.MINI is an anonymized aggregated component-venue BBO, not SIP NBBO or private fills. Native side denotes initiating trade side when supplied. No passive queue inference. A positive candidate needs routeable quote corroboration and realistic execution before reliability testing.
timing: Entry reference=decision+50us processing+assumed one-way delay+fixed scenario clock shift. Exit reference=entry reference+holding period. Same deterministic timeline per scenario and event; no favorable future timestamp selection. Latency is an explicit research assumption, not measured client access. This aggregated feed does not identify IEX or justify applying an IEX-specific speed bump.
reference: Use last completed book strictly before each fixed RECEIVE-clock arrival,with a later quote bracketing it. Exact equal-capture boundary unknown. Require valid maintained book,receive and native event age<=250ms and native event<=arrival. EQUS.MINI receive chronology is a proxy timeline,not an invented unified matching-engine book.
conditional_fills: Aggressive IOC buy at observed ask if<=fixed limit;assumed filled shares=min(fixed requested quantity,future displayed ask size). Unfilled remainder canceled. Force sell assumed filled quantity at observed bid at fixed exit time only if displayed bid size covers it;otherwise remaining inventory and PnL unknown. Commission applies even to partial fill. Hidden liquidity,routeability,NBBO protection,actual acceptance and private fills are unproven.
family: SPY source sweep followed by a causal projected price gap in an index follower
relationship: Unchanged signal and cost thresholds applied to all252cached2024sessions after the2023supply screen was empty. Further discovery across a different period,not validation of an established edge. Prior unrelated work has used2024data;do not claim a globally untouched holdout.
leader: Enumerate all completed SPY trade-bearing groups in each local2024session with the EXACT frozen research/equity_sweep.py predicate used in2023. Preserve accepted and rejected groups,counts and raw indexes. Any BAD_TS_RECV SPY session stays unassessable;other follower source errors remain explicit.
decision: First whole millisecond strictly after SPY burst capture+1ms;cutoff decision-1ms;09:30:05..09:39:30ET. Common reference cutoff exactly1s earlier. Latest F_LAST quote strictly before each cutoff,positive uncrossed cent prices,spread<=5bp,no fallback from invalid latest state. Current SPY capture/event ages<=5ms;all other snapshots<=250ms;native event<=its own cutoff. Current SPY book must include completed burst;both SPY bid and ask must move in burst direction since1s reference.
targets: After a buy SPY burst,only longSSO/UPRO are eligible. After a sell SPY burst,only longSH/SDS/SPXU are eligible. No short sale or borrowed share. Both target snapshots obey the same completed-book/clock gates.
projection: Let L0,L1 be common-anchor/current SPY mids;T0 target anchor mid;beta the named fund's daily multiplier. Projected target mid=T0*(1+beta*(L1/L0-1)). Subtract the CURRENT target half-spread and round DOWN to cents to form hypothetical liquidation price. This daily-beta local response is an unverified one-second model,not guaranteed convergence,NAV equivalence or actual arbitrage.
sizing: Buy limit102%of current target ask rounded UP to cents. Quantity=min(floor10000USD/limit,floor10%current target bid quantity,floor10%current target ask quantity). Fixed before future references; no future resizing.
admission: Current ask-to-current bid cost<=12bp. Hypothetical ask-to-projected-bid cash must net>=2bp of entry notional after unchanged conservative per-order commissions,levy and adverse allowance. Use exact Decimal arithmetic and integer prices. Do not use future follower prices to select candidates.
ranking: One shared long slot. Order all qualifying candidates by decision time,descending projected net USD,descending projected net bp,symbol,leader source index. Require6s global and60s symbol cooldown;selected event starts cooldown independent of later fills. Same selected cohort for1s and5s horizons.
aggregation: Twoeconomic hold configurations,8cases each only if admission exists. Keep inherited unknown symbol/date conditions as full-calendar unknown. Report known components and observed selected-cohort results separately. No zero for unresolved inventory,unknown entry or missing signal. Diagnostic sums are not an executed portfolio.
validation: Eight new focused causal/clock/model/selection tests passed. Independently verify every leader group,reference clock,model price,cost and ranking. A positive realized conditional result needs complete rejection enumeration,execution/NBBO corroboration,concentration/multiple-search controls and newly frozen temporal validation. Do not lower thresholds after seeing this screen.
network: Local immutable DBN reads only,no Databento API client,paid call,new download,account mutation or order.
objective_source_scope: Issuer pages checked2026-10-03UTC for fund identity and daily objectives only. Their definitions do not guarantee second-scale beta;historical product details remain necessary if a candidate survives.
source_unknowns: Derive each symbol/date's data-quality errors directly from2024records;do not reuse the2023bad-date list. Such missing admission cannot be zero if a later economic replay is run.
